title: ControllerProfile
description: A controller family of the raw device layer (ADR-0014, spec section 2.4.2), profile data in the style of ADR-0012: the logs a bioreactor controller writes (tag log, alarm log, batch-phase log) and the logging deadbands of its tags. Every numeric parameter is {value, unit, ref} with ref a ledger id; modeled_on lists S### ids that must resolve; the banner line is required. A synthetic format modeled on public documentation, not a real controller file. Since S2e2 (Step 7) the controller emitter and adapter read it: each log column names its role, so one generic emitter and one generic parser serve every family and branch on no profile id.

banner.const: synthetic, modeled on public documentation; not a real instrument file

form.description: iso_utc_offset: the stamp is a UTC instant with its offset in the text (ctrl_neutral). local_wall_clock: year first, a dash, 24 h, to the second, no zone (RQ1 by assumption, ctrl_bench); the adapter entry zone resolves it.
ctrl_neutral writes the unit in its own column, ctrl_bench in parentheses inside the variable name (A171); the adapter rewrites both to unit_tag.signal.role.

phase_model.description: The ISA-88 ids a batch-phase row carries (A170): one recipe, one procedure, one unit procedure and one operation; the phases come from the observable process events (data_model section 7, S2e2 table).

roles.description: The role of each column, in the order of `columns` (the same length): the generic emitter and parser map by role, never by position or by label.
